overview: You wrote Monday's lodge into the almanac for ten of the clock and forty. The Errors at two were already set. You did not write what the paper says. You shut the almanac.

parties.name: William Shakespeare
parties.context: Wrote the lodge hour and did not open the sealed paper onto the page.

key_provisions.text: ten of the clock and forty

assets.name: The Comedy of Errors
assets.disposition: Set the lodge for ten of the clock and forty
